source_notes: Fetched 2026-09-04 from OpenStreetMap Overpass API (overpass-api.de) via: relation["route"="light_rail"]["operator"~"VTA|Valley Transportation Authority",i]; with full recursive member data (out body; >; out body qt;) to get tags on stop nodes. Overpass returned 8 route relations: two directional relations each for Orange Line (rel 10561835/10561836), Green Line (rel 2989877/9897506), and Blue Line Baypointe<->Santa Teresa (rel 2989876/9897507), plus two additional relations for a shorter Blue Line pattern 'Civic Center <-> Santa Teresa' (rel 17301585/17301586) which is a subset of the full Baypointe-Santa Teresa Blue Line stop sequence (i.e. omits the Baypointe-to-Civic Center segment) -- likely representing a short-turn/peak-only pattern or partially stale route variant in OSM, not used here since the full Baypointe-Santa Teresa relation is the current canonical VTA Blue Line. For each of the 3 canonical lines, the forward and reverse-direction relations' stop sequences were cross-checked and are exact mirror images of each other (26 stops each, all unique, no gaps/duplicates), giving high confidence the topology is clean and complete. Station names came from the 'name' tag on each route relation's role=stop member (a railway=stop node), not from role=platform members (which are unnamed platform ways in this dataset). All 59 stations in the ordered lists exactly match the user's 59-station reference list with one cosmetic difference: OSM uses a curly apostrophe in 'Children’s Discovery Museum' (normalized here to straight apostrophe 'Children's Discovery Museum' to match reference). No reference stations were missing from the OSM data and no OSM stations were extra/unmatched. 19 stations are shared junction/shared-trackage stops appearing on two of the three lines (Blue+Green share the downtown San Jose trunk: Tasman, River Oaks, Orchard, Bonaventura, Component, Karina, Metro/Airport, Gish, Civic Center, Japantown/Ayer, Saint James, Santa Clara, San Antonio, Convention Center; Green+Orange share the North San Jose/Santa Clara segment: Old Ironsides, Great America, Lick Mill, Champion; Blue+Orange share only Baypointe). No station appears on all 3 lines.
